verdict.rationale: Atlas documents serving as your Delaware registered agent for compliance, and one hands-on user says they liked Atlas's filing reminders. That suggests some deadline alerting, but no first-party documentation describes annual report or franchise tax deadline alerts, their timing, or coverage. Missing for 10: first-party docs on annual report and franchise tax deadline alerts, how far ahead alerts arrive, explicit coverage of each state where Atlas acts as agent (evidence shows only Delaware), and independent corroboration beyond a single comment.
